high_pole.base_text: I am looking forward to the new football season.  I can't wait for it.
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I am anticipating the start of the new football season.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: The new football season is almost here, and I've been counting down the days nonstop.

high_pole.base_text: I can't wait!  I am going on a vacation to Rome, Italy in a couple weeks!
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I am going on a vacation to Rome, Italy in a couple weeks.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: Counting down the days until I leave for Rome—I’ve been looking forward to this for so long.

high_pole.base_text: I dropped my friend's birthday cake on some kid.
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I accidentally dropped my friend's birthday cake onto a child.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: I dropped my friend's birthday cake on a kid; now I'm just waiting to see what kind of reaction this will cause.

high_pole.base_text: I am going on a cruise to the Bahamas next month. I have been waiting for this for so long. I cannot wait.
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I am going on a cruise to the Bahamas next month. I have planned this for a long time. I am prepared for it.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: The Bahamas cruise next month has been in my mind for ages; I keep picturing all the fun that’s coming soon.

high_pole.base_text: It was a time of my life where i liked spooky things. I went into a abandoned house and i decided to spend the night. Well i started hearing noises and voices and i just was so scared i ran out the house.
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: At a certain period, I was interested in spooky things. I entered an abandoned house and chose to stay there overnight. Then I began to hear noises and voices, so I left the house quickly.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: I was curious to see what the night in the abandoned house would bring, but those noises definitely made me wonder what was going to happen next.

low_pole.base_text: I miss when my daughter was a baby... I feel like it's all a blur now
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I recall the time when my daughter was a baby, but many of those memories seem unclear now.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: Even though it’s all a blur now, I find myself looking forward to making new memories with my daughter that won’t fade as fast.

low_pole.base_text: MY kids eat everything thing I buy as soon as i buy it. We can never keep groceries
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: My children consume all the groceries immediately after I purchase them. We are unable to store any groceries for later.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: Knowing my kids, I'll be buying groceries again before the day is over since they eat everything so fast.

low_pole.base_text: I was so bored last night.  I live by myself, just me and my dog.
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I spent last night without many activities. I live alone with my dog.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: Last night was boring, but I'm hoping something more interesting happens soon since it's just me and my dog.

low_pole.base_text: My friends just recently purchased a new 2019 Honda Civic.  I am truly angry; I shouldn't be, but I am.  I should be the one with the new car.
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: My friends recently bought a new 2019 Honda Civic. I am upset about it, although I believe I should not be. I think that I should be the one who has the new car.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: Since my friends have a new car now, maybe it'll motivate me to get mine soon.

low_pole.base_text: I forgot my best friend's birthday this year. I've known him forever and am usually great about remebering and doing special thigns.
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I did not remember my best friend's birthday this year. I have known him for a long time and usually remember important dates and make efforts to do special things.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: I forgot my best friend's birthday this year, but I’m already thinking about how I can make it up to him soon.
